title: Fixed Toothed Rack and Opposed Grip Wire Strainer
description: One complete newly authored static rack-type fence-wire-strainer-like tool exterior. A long bar has integral blunt rack teeth; an open U carriage surrounds it and carries a raised long hand lever, transverse pivot and short pawl-like tab. The fixed end and carriage each reach sideways to an opposed open C jaw housing with a complete blunt eccentric cam, leaving real lower mouth gaps. No wire is included. This is not a drum winch, webbing ratchet buckle or chain hoist renamed: the continuous rack, sliding-body exterior and two opposed grips create the whole organisation. All geometry newly authored. One static prop zero scenes, display-resting on finite housing and carriage backs. No working clamp, ratchet engagement, sliding, tension, load capacity, wire compatibility, fabrication, ergonomic or safety performance; mechanisms, interaction and animation unmade.
